# `scripts/arena-census.py --selftest`'s expectation.
#
#     <twin> <T1 verdict> <T2 verdict>   # <file>  T1 <theorem>  T2 <theorem>
#
# The first three fields are compared; the rest of the line is the evidence,
# for a human reading a mismatch.  Verdicts: `closed`, `sorry` (stated, not
# proved), `part` (some of the citing Rust functions have a lemma, not all),
# `.` (nothing stated), `-` (listed in this fixture's own skip file).
#
# Twenty rows and exactly twenty: `instantiate1ArmApp` and
# `instantiate1ArmBVar` are ARMS and must NOT appear — they fold into
# `instantiate1Go`, whose `closed` verdict counts `instantiate1ArmApp_spec`
# as well as `instantiate1Go_spec`.
